title: orders.order.refunded
description: Staff refunded a paid order in full through the PAYMENT provider (partial refunds are not built). The order's status and payment_status are now refunded, and the checkout hooks get release with reason cancelled, as on cancel: a companion returns stock, gives a code use back, cancels a shipment. Emitted once per order. user_id is null for a guest account. attempt_key is the checkout idempotency key of the order (absent for an order placed before 0.2.0). Money is a decimal string. Key = order id. Since 0.2.0.
